applies_why: The judge issued an UNDERDETERMINED verdict, so K-S2 governs whether that verdict rests on a forbidden single-verse silence ground.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: 'single verse does not state a link' — I weighed whether this bars only citing one verse's silence as the ground, or also bars comparing the support of two full chains; I read it as the former.
why: The judge's stated ground is that the competing chains do not force each other, not that a single verse fails to state the link or its contrary.
